title: The helper was not on the list
body: The clinic key is attached to a note saying one patient did not become ill; the return sheet lists the helper as absent.
rival_reading: A field trial might record an unaffected worker and a clinic visit; the absent helper does not show a failed evacuation.
gloss: A clinic note and an absent helper leave a care handoff incomplete.

cites.quote: Jolene didn't get sick. She can help.
